Name: Enhanced Slingshots
Author: ytsc
Description:
[b][size=4]Info[/size][/b]

This mod adds the unused Galaxy Slingshot, a new Infinity Slingshot, a set of Enchantments for slingshots and new ammos. It comes with editable configurations for the slingshots. You can see the details below.

[b][size=3]New Slingshots:[/size][/b]

[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/4/4c/Galaxy_Slingshot.png[/img]
[b][size=2]Galaxy Slingshot
[/size][/b]
[b]Damage multiplier:[/b] x3.
[b]How to obtain:[/b] Sold in Adventure Guild Shop after unlocking the Skull Key. Price configurable.

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/TDXc9MS.png[/img]
[b]Infinity Slingshot[/b] 

[b]Damage multiplier:[/b] x4.
[b]How to obtain:[/b] You can get after infusing [b]3 Galaxy Souls[/b] on the [b]Galaxy Slingshot. [/b](does not have the tooltip yet)

[size=3][b]New ﻿Enchantments:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Automated:[/b] Auto fire on key hold.
[*][b]Bug Killer[/b]: Deals more damage to insect enemies. Damage is configurable (default: +50%).
[*][b]Expert:[/b] Auto reload the slinghot if you have the same item used as ammo on you inventory.
[*][b]Hunter:[/b] Monsters drop more loot when killed (default: +1). Stacks with Burglar's Ring.
[*][b]Magnetic:[/b] Projectiles collides with ores. List of ores is configurable.
[*][b]Miner:[/b] Ores drops more resources (default: +1). Stacks with Miner Profession.
[*][b]Precise: [/b]Deals more damage to flying enemies. Damage is configurable (default: +50%).
[*][b]Preserving:[/b] Chance to not spend ammo when shooting (default: 50% chance).
[*][b]Swift:[/b] Projectile travels faster (default: 2x).
[*][b]Vampiric:[/b] Chance of health recover when monster is killed (default: 9%).
[/list]﻿
[b][size=3]New Ammo:

[/size][/b][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/9/9f/Radioactive_Ore.png[/img][b]Radioative Ore:[/b] 75 Damage.
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/1/1f/Void_Essence.png[/img][b]Void Essence:[/b] 25 Damage.
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/f/f4/Solar_Essence.png[/img][b]Solar Essence:[/b] 25 Damage.
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/2/24/Petrified_Slime.png[/img][b]Petrified Slime:[/b] 20 Damage.
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/7/74/Earth_Crystal.png[/img][b]Earth Crystal[/b]: 20 Damage.
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/e/ec/Frozen_Tear.png[/img][b]Frozen Tear:[/b] 20 Damage.
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/5/5b/Fire_Quartz.png[/img][b]Fire Quartz:[/b] 20 Damage.
﻿[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/c/cf/Quartz.png[/img][b]Quartz:[/b] 10 Damage.
[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/3/38/Slime.png[/img][b]Slime:[/b] 5 Damage.


[b][size=3]Configurations: [/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]EnableGalaxySligshot:[/b] If the Galaxy Slingshot is enabled to sell at the Adventure Guild Shop (default: true).
[*][b]GalaxySlingshotPrice:[/b] The Galaxy Slingshot price (default: 75000).
[*][b]InfinitySlingshotId:[/b] The ID for the Infinity Slingshot (default: 135). Only change if you have conflicts with other mods.
[*][b]SlingshotAutoFireRate:[/b] The frequency which a new projectile is shoot with the [b]Automated[/b] enchantment (default: 0.5 seconds).
[*][b]BugKillerEnchantment_Damage:[/b] The extra damage of [b]Bug Killer[/b] enchantment (default: 1.5 = +50%).
[*][b]PreciseEnchantment_Damage:[/b] The extra damage of [b]Precise[/b] enchantment (default: 1.5 = +50%).
[*][b]HunterEnchantment_ExtraDropsAmount[/b]: The amount of monsters extra drops of [b]Hunter[/b] enchantment (default +1).
[*][b]MinerEnchantment_ExtraDropsAmount:[/b] The amount of ore extra drops of [b]Miner [/b]enchantment (default +1).
[*][b]PreservingEnchantment_PreserveChance:[/b] The chance of not using ammo of [b]Preserving [/b]enchantment (default: 0.5 = 50%).
[*][b]SwiftEnchantment_TimesFaster:[/b] The projectile extra speed of [b]Swift [/b]enchantment (default: 2).
[*][b]VampiricEnchantment_RecoveryChance:[/b] The chance of health recover on monster kill of [b]Vampiric [/b]enchantment (default 0.09 = 9%).
[*][b]MagneticEnchantment_AffectedStones:[/b] The list of stones that the projectile collides when slingshot has [b]Magnetic [/b]enchantment. You can find the ID's [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Items/Object_sprites]here[/url]﻿.
[*][b]ItemsThatCanBeUsedAsAmmo:[/b] The list of items that can be used as ammo and the respective damages. You can find the ID's [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Items/Object_sprites]here[/url]﻿.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Install[/b]
[/size]1. Install latest version of SMAPI.
2. Place the EnhancedSlingshots mod folder on the mods folder of your game.

[b][size=4]Uninstall[/size][/b]
1. Remove the EnhancedSlingshots mod folder from the mods folder of your game.
